name: MonarchAiAgentRunTimeline
title: AiAgentRunTimeline
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of clickable event rows with bars drawn on androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas, androidx.compose.material3.SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow for the view, and a table in Modifier.horizontalScroll; MonarchBadge, MonarchTabularNumber and MonarchButton
summary: The trace of one agent run: every model call, tool call and hand-off as a bar on a shared time axis, totals for time, tokens and cost, and details that open per event, with a table view of the same data.
whenToUse: In a developer or operator view of an agent: to see where a run spent its time, tokens and money, and to jump from an event to the conversation part it produced.
whenNotToUse: For the steps an assistant shows the person while it works, use MonarchAiChainOfSteps. For usage over a period, use MonarchAiUsageMeter or a chart.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchAiAgentRunTimeline(events: List<MonarchAiRunEvent>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, currency: String = "USD", now: Long? = null, mode: MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineMode? = null, onModeChange: ((MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineMode) -> Unit)? = null, initialMode: MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineMode = MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineMode.Timeline, onOpenPart: ((MonarchAiRunEvent) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineLabels = MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineLabels())

public data class MonarchAiRunEvent(id: String, kind: MonarchAiRunEventKind, name: String, startedAt: Long, endedAt: Long? = null, inputTokens: Long? = null, outputTokens: Long? = null, costMicros: Long? = null, detail: String? = null, partId: String? = null, messageId: String? = null)
public enum class MonarchAiRunEventKind { Model, Tool, Handoff, Error }
public enum class MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineMode { Timeline, Table }

public class MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineLabels(label: String? = null, modeLabel: String? = null, mode: ((MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineMode) -> String)? = null, kind: ((MonarchAiRunEventKind) -> String)? = null, events: String? = null, totalDuration: String? = null, inputTokens: String? = null, outputTokens: String? = null, cost: String? = null, start: String? = null, duration: String? = null, eventColumn: String? = null, kindColumn: String? = null, running: String? = null, empty: String? = null, notAvailable: String? = null, openPart: String? = null, formatDuration: ((Long) -> String)? = null, formatOffset: ((Long) -> String)? = null)

options.name: events
options.description: The run's events in any order: kind, name, start and end in epoch milliseconds (end null while running), tokens, cost in micros, a detail text, and the conversation part or message it belongs to.

options.name: currency
options.description: The ISO 4217 currency of costMicros. An unknown code is written after the number.

options.name: now
options.description: The end of events that are still running, in epoch milliseconds. Without it they end at the latest known time, so the trace never reads the clock.

options.name: mode
options.description: The view, timeline or table. Without it the component keeps the state.

options.name: onModeChange
options.description: Called when the person switches the view; set mode in it when the app holds the state.

options.name: initialMode
options.description: The first view when the component keeps the state.

options.name: onOpenPart
options.description: Adds "Show in conversation" to an open event that has a partId or a messageId.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, and the duration and offset formats.

states.name: timeline
states.description: A time axis (start, middle, end), then one row per event with its kind badge, name, duration and bar.

states.name: open event
states.description: Start offset, duration, the known tokens and cost, the detail in the code style, and Show in conversation.

states.name: running
states.description: "Running" instead of a duration, and a bar that fades into the AI thinking color.

states.name: error
states.description: The kind badge in the danger tone and a danger bar.

states.name: table
states.description: Event, kind, start, duration, input and output tokens and, when any event has one, cost; unknown values show "–". Scrolls sideways.

appearance: Bars use the AI solid color for model calls, the AI tool color for tools, info solid for hand-offs and danger solid for errors, on a muted track. Totals are strong body text in tabular figures with muted captions. All colors are theme roles, so dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Same parameters as iOS, with Android types: times are epoch milliseconds, counts and costs are Long, and the view is a nullable mode with onModeChange instead of a Binding. Bars are drawn on a Canvas inside each event's row, so the bar, the header and the details form one row for touch and TalkBack. The web draws a moving shimmer on running bars; Android draws a still gradient, so there is nothing to stop when animations are removed. The web's detail is any React node; on Android it is text. The axis shows three ticks instead of five, for phone widths. Costs below one unit keep up to four decimals, so a model call of a fraction of a cent does not read as zero.
accessibility: The trace is a traversal group named "Agent run"; the visible heading has the heading role.
Each total is one element, such as "Total time, 4.2 s".

Each event is one button read as its kind, name and duration, such as "Tool, search_invoices, 1.6 s", with an Expanded or Collapsed state and expand and collapse actions; a running event says "Running".
Bars and the axis are hidden, so nothing depends on their color or length.
Each fact of an open event is its own text; Show in conversation is a button with a 48dp touch target.
In the table each row is one element with every known value; unknown values are left out of what is read.
The view switch is a Material 3 segmented button row named "View".
edgeCases: Events are sorted by start; equal starts keep their order.
An event that ends before it starts is drawn with no length.
An instant event keeps a 2dp bar.
Long names wrap in the timeline and widen the table, which scrolls.

        events = listOf(
        MonarchAiRunEvent(

            name = {{events.0.name}},

            name = {{events.1.name}},

            endedAt = {{events.1.endedAt|millis}},
            detail = {{events.1.detail}},
        ),
        MonarchAiRunEvent(
            id = {{events.2.id}},

            name = {{events.2.name}},
            startedAt = {{events.2.startedAt|millis}},
            endedAt = {{events.2.endedAt|millis}},
        ),
        MonarchAiRunEvent(
            id = {{events.3.id}},
            kind = MonarchAiRunEventKind.{{events.3.kind|pascal}},

examples.title: The table, with the view held by the app
examples.setup:
var mode by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(MonarchAiAgentRunTimelineMode.Table) }
val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L
examples.code:
MonarchAiAgentRunTimeline(
    events = listOf(MonarchAiRunEvent("1", MonarchAiRunEventKind.Tool, "lookup_customer", t0, t0 + 420)),
    mode = mode,
    onModeChange = { mode = it },
)
